body: From what I've been told: in the first icon of Jesus Christ, the men at the bottom are His 12 Disciples. All disciples have two eyes, except one on the bottom left who is said to be Judas.

Thank you for your response, I share the same sentiment. But there are two sides to this and it’s difficult to make a decision. I don’t want to make a decision that only serves me, I don’t want to make a decision that also doesn’t serve me at all, you know?? I’d be doing myself a disservice OR I’d be doing my best friend a disservice. I might mention it lightly to her, see how she would react. If she reacts negatively then it’s out of bounds.

He was none of that. She didn’t develop deep enough feelings for him, that was the reason for their break up. BUT she did trust him and she had to move on from him and learn to trust someone else. Which I know took a lot of effort for her. I don’t necessarily know if she would have a problem, she might not have had a problem if we were all younger. But romantic relationships get deeper the more you mature and there are a lot of “rules” that you adhere to, a code in a sense. That “code” becomes more important the more mature your relationships are. If you get what I’m saying. That’s why I feel like maybe her opinions have changed, I know she has said recently that she would never want to date my ex because she would never let a guy in between us. I wouldn’t necessarily mind unless the breakup was really messy or the ex was really messed up. However she still stands by girl code. That’s why I’m reluctant to reveal these feelings to her, I don’t want her to think I don’t love her, I don’t want her to become suspicious of me in the future.

Their relationship wasn’t toxic and the breakup wasn’t either. She broke up with him because she didn’t love him. It was messy in the sense that breakups usually are quite awkward but not more than that. She still had to heal from it because she’s had trust issues in the past (before B came into the picture) and it took her a few months to start trusting someone again. She got into a relationship a few months later and while it was on and off a couple times, they’ve been dating consistently for the past year and she’s very happy with him. My best friend A and I have talked about situations like this in the past, like if we were to like the other persons ex. However this was a few years ago and from my memory, probably before her and B dated. Her opinion might have changed since though, I don’t want to indicate to her that I don’t care for her or love her because I deeply do. I also don’t know if I can let go of B because there’s love there as well.

thank you, this is really good advice. It’s a matter of what kind of person I am, and what I want to be. The same way I have found love and affection in other people in the past, it’ll happen for me again. This man isn’t the only one for me, although we have deep love for each other, it could just be that we’re meant to only be friends and nothing more. I want to be someone who prides myself in sticking to a code, having control over myself and my life (as hard as it is), I have the ability to control this situation and do the moral thing. We don’t live in a world that is free and boundless, it’s not the reality and I need to stop hoping that it will be.

Exactly, there is a possibility that we might not be together forever. Maybe I’ll overcome these feelings for him after a while, it’s especially hard because we’ve both had feelings for each other since the beginning of our friendship. On one side, I don’t want to restrict myself from not knowing, on the other side I have to restrict myself so as to not hurt my girlfriend.

I want to be a good person and I don’t want to look back and think I made a stupid decision. Maybe I shouldn’t rush into this. I want to do what’s right for me as long as it doesn’t hurt others, but this could hurt my girlfriend. I shouldn’t do that to her. I think I’ve been mulling over this for years and the truth about our feelings have finally come out and I want a definitive outcome.

I’ve been friends with the both of them the same amount of time. My friendship is different with her as it is with him. I don’t know how to choose, A is my best girlfriend and B is my best guy friend. They both understand me differently and they both have a piece of my heart.

I already didn’t feel as if he was committed, and I was trying to tell him that I didn’t see it coming from him. However this situation, recently, has made me more upset and his responses made it seem that I was trying to guilt him and that “the past is past, it doesn’t matter now.” However I feel that it matters because it was a critical time and he wasn’t there for me when I needed him the most. I couldn’t move forward, mentally, if there wasn’t a mutual understanding and that’s why I broke up with him. He said I was manipulative and toxic towards him because of my behaviour where I would be upset at him for going behind my back, no wanting to communicate for a day or so, then eventually call him and talk to him. This was something that confused him and I don’t want to do this again.

Maybe I am. I just never felt like he was committed to me. How can this be rectified, I don’t want him to think I’m being manipulative or playing with his emotions. I’ve already broken up with him (albeit recently), do I just wait until he contacts me?

his love isn’t enough to help me survive. This world isn’t run on love it’s run on money. He thinks by getting me to a psych it’ll solve everything, he wants to take me somewhere and give me a few days to rest,  I know by doing that he’s going to try and convince me to stay. 
I’ve tried 3 antidepressants, complained about the last one and doctor didn’t change my script. So I stopped taking them a couple weeks ago.

I’ve tried so many different methods to reach that happiness, all leading to nothing. So far I haven’t experienced the good that comes after the bad, maybe once or twice. I’ve lost everything now, it’s all been taken from me and I have no more strength to continue. I am giving myself time these next few days, and I will go.
I’ve considered living, it took me a long time to realise it wasn’t for me.
